name: 24651 · Tazewell, VA
findings: ZIP 24651 (Tazewell) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (61%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24651 (Tazewell) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 24651 (Tazewell) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).
